notes.title: Shadow Touched - Patch 0.8.1. EA
notes.content:
[h1]Mechanics[/h1]
[list]
[*] Implemented Dash mechanic:
[list]
[*] A dash can be performed when the player moves right or left, is in the air, and presses and holds X.
[*] A dash lasts for a maximum of 0.7 seconds.
[*] Releasing the Dash button before it reaches the maximum duration will interrupt the Dash immediately.
[*] The player can only dash once and resets every time the player stands on a platform.
[*] A Dash can only be made in the normal dimension.
[/list]
[*] Increased the animation speed of the attack animation in the normal dimension by 15%.
[*] The duration to stay in the Shadow dimension is no longer a random number between 8.25 and 10.25, but rather a fixed 9 seconds.
[*] Standardized the hitbox of spikes to be the same as every other spike.
[/list]
[h1]Power-ups[/h1]
[list]
[*] Hitbox of power-ups increased by 11.54%.
[*] Changed the icon of [b]Jump Impulse[/b].
[*] Power-ups now respawn after 3.5 seconds.
[*] Power-ups now actually have names:
[list]
[*] [b]Double Jump[/b]: Allows Twilight to jump an additional time.
[*] [b]Light Shard[/b]: Grants a 1-up.
[*] [b]Darkness Dispersal[/b]: Removes a percentage of darkness. The higher the current darkness, the more it removes.
[*] [b]Jump Impulse[/b]: Shoots Twilight vertically.
[*] [b]Speed Boost[/b]: Grants increased movement speed for a short duration.
[*] [b]Darkness Dispersal[/b]: amount removed increased from 38% to 40%.
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*] Removed BGM intro of the loopable part, because it was causing a weird audio gap between the two soundtracks (intro and loopable files).
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the player would display the wrong sprite while utilizing the Jump Impulse power-up.
[/list]
